purpose: Freeze the reusable Hero Dungeon supplemental consumer after B1-B4 complete, without reopening raw ConfigData interpretation or the primary Hero lifecycle.

inScope: Freeze the B1-B4 validated supplemental Hero Dungeon facet for downstream exact-ID reuse.
Validate consumer membership, explicit gate ordinals, reference counts, predecessor hashes, and accepted 5/7 populations from frozen repository artifacts only.
Keep NO_HERO_DUNGEON entries explicit and non-blocking.
outOfScope: Recompute canonical Hero identity, Fetter semantics, or Stage 5/6 outputs.
Add localization, frontend presentation, asset, release, or hosted behavior.
Infer gate order from array position, ID arithmetic, PreLevel_ID, names, filenames, or UI order.

checks.name: final consumer contains exactly 267 canonical Hero facets
B3 normalized ordinal assignment hash preserved
B3 normalized Hero ordinal-set hash preserved
B4 accepted Hero ID hashes preserved

handoff.nextStart: Hero Dungeon supplemental semantics are closed. Any localization/frontend integration is a separate owner and must consume data/generated/hero-dungeon-supplemental-final.v1.json without raw fallback.

reopenConditions: The pinned ConfigData semantic snapshot changes.
The primary canonical Hero population changes from the frozen 267-Hero authority.
A B1-B4 owning validator reports a hard failure or authoritative contradiction.
The explicit HeroDungeonLevelInfo.NameNum ordinal relation or cardinality acceptance contract changes.
